title: Registered property, dispute about it, publication of the petition not stated: ask

expect.why: Text: «يجب إشهار عريضة رفع الدعوى لدى المحافظة العقارية، إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر ... تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار». Both conditions are met, so the step is required; whether it was done (or deposited for publication) is not given, so the rule must ask, not assume it was not done. No existing slot holds the step itself (see reply).

title: Dispute not about real property: the publication duty does not apply

expect.why: Text: «إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر». The petition does not concern real property, so the condition of the duty is false and publication is not required; the rule must stay silent (no block, no question). Outcome stepExempt stands for 'step not required'.

title: Real property dispute, property not published at the land registry: does the duty reach it?

expect.why: The text does not settle this: «بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر طبقا للقانون». If «مشهر» qualifies both nouns, an unpublished property is outside the duty; if it qualifies only the real right, any real property is inside it. The words «و/أو» add to the doubt. The rule must warn, not decide.

title: Registration of the property unknown, publication of the petition not stated: ask

expect.why: Whether the duty applies depends on «مشهر» (under the reading that it qualifies the property); the fact is unknown, so the rule must ask for property_registered and not treat unknown as 'no'.

title: Whether the dispute concerns real property is unknown

expect.why: Text: «إذا تعلقت بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر». One of the two conditions is unknown, the other true: the rule cannot decide whether the duty applies and must ask for dispute_concerns_real_property.

title: Family dispute, but the court has no family section (or it was merged): the text is silent

expect.why: Text: «ينظر قسم شؤون الأسرة، على الخصوص في الدعاوى الآتية: ... 2 - دعاوى النفقة والحضانة وحق الزيارة». The article gives the family section the maintenance claim; the texts given do not say before which formation the claim goes when the court has no such section. The rule must warn, not decide.

title: Registered property dispute with the publication step not stated, petition for partition of an estate

expect.why: Partition of an estate is a claim concerning real property when the estate holds real property, and the property is published: the duty of «إشهار عريضة رفع الدعوى» applies, as in bc1. Whether it was done is unknown, so the rule must ask. The estate character of the partition does not remove the duty: the text has no exception.

title: Defendant's residence abroad unknown: 20 days or 3 months between service and first hearing

expect.why: Text: «يجب احترام أجل عشرين (20) يوما على الأقل بين تاريخ تسليم التكليف بالحضور، والتاريخ المحدد لأول جلسة» (¶3) and «يمدد هذا الأجل ... إلى ثلاثة (3) أشهر، إذا كان الشخص المكلف بالحضور مقيما في الخارج» (¶4). Which period applies depends on defendant_resides_abroad, which is unknown: the rule must ask for it. The last day cannot be computed: the dates of service and of the first hearing have no slot (see reply).
